newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair June seat load factor 74.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swissair June seat load factor 74.2 pct.

text.p: Swissair's seat load factor rose to 74.2 percent in June from 67.7 percent in the same month last year, a company spokesman said.
Swissair, a unit of SAirGroup, used to publish traffic figures monthly, but stopped this policy earlier this year.
Further details about the June and half-year traffic figures were not available, but will be published together with the financial results on August 21, the spokesman added.
In March, the last time SAirGroup published a seat load factor, Swissair's seat load factor was 70.3 percent.
SAirGroup's target is for Swissair to have a seat load factor of 70 percent for 1997, up from 64.6 percent in 1996.
